# Parallax

> Parallax is a dashboard theme kit for shadcn-svelte (Svelte 5, Tailwind v4): a palette of
> 12 themes over one token set, four persisted appearance axes (inverted sidebar/header,
> floating header, auto-hide), an installable application shell, and a gallery of patterns.
> Distribution is a shadcn-svelte registry: source is copied into the consumer project.

## Registry items

Install with `npx shadcn-svelte@latest add <url>`. Post-install notes: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OctarinaCompany/svelte-theme-parallax/main/docs/REGISTRY.md

- [parallax-theme](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-theme.json): The Parallax palette: the base light and dark tokens, the eleven alternate palettes behind `data-theme`, and the Tailwind mappings for the token families shadcn does not ship — success, warning, info, the subtle family, and `--sidebar-outline`.
- [parallax-appearance](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-appearance.json): The four appearance axes as persisted state: an inverted sidebar, an inverted header, a floating header and a header that hides on scroll down. Module-level runes that write attributes on `<html>`, plus the CSS those attributes key on.
- [parallax-appearance-controls](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-appearance-controls.json): The two dropdown menus that drive the axes: one for the sidebar (inverted, floating) and one for the header (inverted, floating, hide on scroll). Drop them in a header and the axes become user-facing.
- [parallax-swap](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-swap.json): A two-state icon crossfade — the house primitive behind the light/dark toggle. Not in the official registry, which is why it ships from here.
- [parallax-shell](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-shell.json): The application shell: the sidebar (workspace switcher, two-shape navigation, user menu, icon rail, mobile drawer) and the page header bar (breadcrumb, search slot, appearance controls) — wired to the published appearance axes, taking their content as typed props.
- [parallax-skill](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-skill.json): The Agent Skill that teaches an AI assistant to use Parallax correctly: registry installation, shell composition, the token families, the palettes and the appearance axes, with the pitfalls spelled out. Installs into the project's `.claude/skills/parallax/`.
- [parallax-primitives](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-primitives.json): Shared infrastructure the house components compose: roving focus, form-control bridging, the TanStack table bridge, scroll position, DOM-ordered collections. Installed automatically as a dependency; rarely asked for by name.
- [parallax-restyle](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-restyle.json): The Parallax shape for the OFFICIAL components: css-only restyles of switch, checkbox, tooltip, inputs, native-select, select, sliders, sonner, navigation-menu, kbd, command and the tabs line variant, plus the global menu-shadow and dialog-scrim opinions. Install once beside parallax-theme.
- [parallax-accordion](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-accordion.json): The Parallax fork of the official accordion: the same API with the house refinements this theme depends on.
- [parallax-action-bar](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-action-bar.json): The floating bulk-selection bar: a count, grouped actions, and an Escape that defers to open overlays.
- [parallax-alert](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-alert.json): The Parallax fork of the official alert: the same API with the house refinements this theme depends on.
- [parallax-alert-dialog](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-alert-dialog.json): The Parallax fork of the official alert-dialog: the same API with the house refinements this theme depends on.
- [parallax-angle-slider](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-angle-slider.json): Parallax's angle slider component — not in the official shadcn-svelte registry.
- [parallax-autocomplete](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-autocomplete.json): Parallax's autocomplete component — not in the official shadcn-svelte registry.
- [parallax-avatar](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-avatar.json): The house avatar: shadcn's API plus a size ramp and the hairline ring treatment.
- [parallax-badge](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-badge.json): The house badge: shadcn's API plus the soft *-subtle variants for every status family.
- [parallax-badge-overflow](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-badge-overflow.json): Parallax's badge overflow component — not in the official shadcn-svelte registry.
- [parallax-banner](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-banner.json): Parallax's banner component — not in the official shadcn-svelte registry.
- [parallax-breadcrumb](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-breadcrumb.json): The Parallax fork of the official breadcrumb: the same API with the house refinements this theme depends on.
- [parallax-button](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-button.json): The house button: shadcn's API on the --control-h-* ramp (24/32/40/48px), with xs/icon-xs sizes and the data-icon slots.
- [parallax-button-group](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-button-group.json): The Parallax fork of the official button-group: the same API with the house refinements this theme depends on.
- [parallax-calendar](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-calendar.json): The Parallax fork of the official calendar: the same API with the house refinements this theme depends on.
- [parallax-card](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-card.json): The house card: shadcn's API plus a size prop and the ring-drawn outline.
- [parallax-carousel](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-carousel.json): The Parallax fork of the official carousel: the same API with the house refinements this theme depends on.
- [parallax-chart](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-chart.json): The Parallax fork of the official chart: the same API with the house refinements this theme depends on.

- [parallax-data-table](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-data-table.json): The TanStack-driven table engine: createDataTable state in runes, Toolbar with meta-driven filters, ColumnHeader, FlexRender, Pagination. The motor behind every list page in the gallery.

- [parallax-timeline](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-timeline.json): Parallax's timeline component — not in the official shadcn-svelte registry.
- [parallax-toggle](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-toggle.json): The Parallax fork of the official toggle: the same API with the house refinements this theme depends on.
- [parallax-toggle-group](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-toggle-group.json): The Parallax fork of the official toggle-group: the same API with the house refinements this theme depends on.
- [parallax-tooltip](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-tooltip.json): The Parallax fork of the official tooltip: the same API with the house refinements this theme depends on.
- [parallax-tour](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-tour.json): Parallax's tour component — not in the official shadcn-svelte registry.
- [parallax-tree](https://octarinacompany.github.io/svelte-theme-parallax/r/parallax-tree.json): Parallax's tree component — not in the official shadcn-svelte registry.

## Guides

- [Registry guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OctarinaCompany/svelte-theme-parallax/main/docs/REGISTRY.md): every item's post-install notes, wiring sample, first-paint script
- [Theme system](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OctarinaCompany/svelte-theme-parallax/main/docs/THEME.md): the base palette, the OKLCH ladder, the token mapping, the audit
- [Conventions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OctarinaCompany/svelte-theme-parallax/main/docs/CONVENTIONS.md): the house rules the source follows
- [AI skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OctarinaCompany/svelte-theme-parallax/main/skills/parallax/SKILL.md): the Agent Skill (install it via the parallax-skill registry item)
- [Pattern recipes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OctarinaCompany/svelte-theme-parallax/main/skills/parallax/references/patterns.md): distilled design recipes of the flagship gallery pages
